title: Fig salad
preamble:
Ingredients:-
Green
figs
Streaky
bacon - thin; roll under rolling pin if too thick
Blue
cheese
Balsamic
vineagar
Salad
leaves
Feta
cheese
Blue
cheese
Tomato
Pomegranate
seeds
Seedless

Method:-
Pre-heat oven to gas mark 5
Cut almost half through each fig, squeeze blue cheese between, close and wrap with bacon.Seal with a cocktail stick.
Place figs on baking plate with the goat's cheese.
Drizzle Balsamic vineagar over the figs.
Bake for 15 to 25 minutes.
After about 10 minutes remove the cheese and after about 15 minutes turn oven to maximum to finish the figs.
Make salad of leaves and arrange on each plate. Scatter the other ingredients over the salad.
Put warmed goat's cheese in centre
When bacon cooked place figs in centre of each plate. .
Sprinkle mint leaves over the plates.
Eat.
